# Rollable Builder

> Rollable Builder is an AI app builder for small businesses. You describe the tool you need in plain words, add spreadsheets, documents or photos if you have them, and a team of AI builders makes it into a working app with lists, forms, boards, dashboards and calendars. You change it by asking, and every change can be undone. Made by Rollable (rollable.app), in early access by invitation.

## Key pages

- [Start page and demo](https://rollable.app/labs/builder/start): describe a tool and watch how it is built, no sign-in needed. Includes "What is Rollable Builder?", who it is for, how it works, and questions and answers.
- [Privacy](https://rollable.app/privacy.html)
- [Terms](https://rollable.app/terms.html)

## Facts

- Who it is for: small businesses such as cafés and bakeries, salons and clinics, trades, shops, studios and freelancers.
- Input: a plain-language description (English or Norwegian), plus optional Excel or CSV spreadsheets, Word documents, PDFs, notes and photos (up to five files of 5 MB each).
- Output: an internal app with its own tables and address; screen kinds are lists, forms, boards, dashboards and calendars. Data can be exported to Excel or CSV.
- Changes: by chat ("add a column for invoice date"); every version is kept and can be undone.
- Team: people are invited to a workspace by email as editors or viewers.
- Data: stored in the EU (database and app servers in Ireland). Files that only AI can read are sent to Claude by Anthropic after the person agrees; data is not used to train AI models.
- Access: early access by invitation. Contact: hello@rollable.app.
- No code is needed.
